"""Build all-case tables and fixed native comparisons after actual quality review."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V174-spread-matching-v1'
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==60
assert read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
assert read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert len(notes.read_text())>300
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');audit=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')
summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
methods=['parent','V169-EMA','V171-EMA','V172-EMA','V173-EMA','V174-raw','V174-EMA'];columns=['V143 parent','V169 EMA','V171 EMA','V172 EMA','V173 EMA','V174 raw','V174 EMA']
text='# V174 spread sample initialization: completed quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and exact sources](results/v174-spread-matching-final-v1.json) · [Native pixels, source ROIs, checkpoint, noise and display metadata](images/v174-spread-matching-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
cells=[];lines=[]
def table(title,specifications):
 global text
 text+='## '+title+'\n\n| Metric | '+' | '.join(columns)+' |\n| --- | '+' | '.join(['---:']*len(columns))+' |\n'
 for label,kind,condition,cohort,field,digits in specifications:
  values=[]
  for method in methods:
   value=summaries[kind,condition,cohort,method][field];rendered=f'{value:.{digits}f}'
   cells.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=method,field=field,digits=digits,rendered=rendered));values.append(rendered)
  line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(values)+' |';lines.append(line);text+=line+'\n'
 text+='\n'
table('Mesh response and actual blank error',[(('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' '+label,'mesh',present,None,field,digits) for present in [True,False] for label,field,digits in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16',6),('signed template gain','template_gain',8),('actual blank RMS','blank_error_RMS_DN16',6),('blank spatial RMS','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16',6),('blank DC RMS','blank_DC_RMS_DN16',6)]])
table('Quiet fields beside detail',[(f'{prior} {label}','mixed-quiet',prior,None,field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('whole RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet RMS','quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet spatial RMS','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('quiet DC RMS','crop_DC_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Native 512-pixel standalone flats',[(f'{prior} {label}','flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Natural photographic detail',[(f'{cohort}/{variant} {label}','photo',variant,cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['retained512','organic384'] for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band response','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]])
design=read(plan['design']['path']);adc=next(c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256')
table('ADC-only controls',[(f'Photo {label}','photo',adc['variant']['name'],adc['cohort'],field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]]+[(f'{cohort} {label}','flat','adc-only',cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['fresh-flat512','adc-sloped512'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])


text+='RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Template gain 1 means exact constructed amplitude; a small signed absent-template mean does not certify absence of false structure. Coarse32 is spatially centered block-mean error. Paired values and increase/decrease counts are retained. This adaptively reused cohort does not establish blind performance or seed uncertainty.\n\n'
text+='## Spread initialization and matched training\n\n'
text+='The pinned sampler adds a unit 3×3 grid to 9*tanh(offset_CNN). V172 starts its final offset-predictor weights/biases at zero. V174 sets only the existing bias vectors to atanh(7*grid/9), giving nominal grid spacing 8 feature pixels. The search bound remains 9. Initial corner distances are 22.63/45.25/90.51 native pixels across scales, compared with 2.83/5.66/11.31. Wider initial samples are not automatically corresponding samples.\n\n'
text+='Only five bias vectors/60 scalar values change; all other 183 state tensors match the V172 initialization exactly. The forward graph, all 96 neural sources, 2,088,906 trainable parameters/141 tensors, frozen V169 EMA/V143-DINO parent, local feature/output units, V168 cache/pair units, all seven criterion terms and AdamW/LR/clipping/EMA are unchanged. The training/runtime/resource/restoration ASTs and criterion bytes match. A zero tail retains the initial V169 RGB. All seven actual initial loss terms, mask and total reproduce V172 exactly. Clean targets/masks/pairs remain training-only. [Initial batch](results/v174-actual-initial-loss-isolation-v1.json) · [Original protocol](results/v174-spread-matching-v1/original-protocol-v1.md).\n\n'
text+='Six prior V172 EMA forwards replay existing fingerprints exactly. Reconstructed sample distances stay below 12.05 native pixels at the coarsest block and 2.72–5.92 in finer blocks on those selected inputs. These are positions reconstructed from captured pre-tanh fields in NumPy FP64, not retained bit-exact CUDA coordinates, full-model receptive fields or causal RGB influence. Convolutions and the frozen DINO parent also supply context. The observation motivates this initialization test without proving why V172 misses crossings. [Baseline probe](results/v174-V172-offset-usage-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='The 1,000 cached rows contain 341 mesh, 243 photo, 156 mixed, 153 flat and 107 weak-detail batches, including V168 fine-wire/contrast coverage. No new source/noise draws, parent/DINO calls or original/dataz reads occur. Both protected capture families, siblings and JPEGs remain excluded; originals are read-only and unused. Zero supplied local variance retains V169 and whole-image ADC controls bypass matching. This is not a noisy-flat guarantee.\n\n'
text+='All 133 focused CPU checks pass, including ten new independent NumPy geometry, exact state/RNG, unit-spacing, repeat-initialization and invalid-parameter checks. New native admission uses three batch-4 512-pixel backwards and one 768-pixel inference, four candidate matching calls/13 images/three discarded updates. Primitive/core parity and adjoints inherit unchanged source/library evidence, not repeated calls. Atomic CUDA sampler input-gradients remain warn-only nondeterministic. [Preparation](results/v174-spread-matching-preparation-v1.json) · [Readiness](results/v174-runtime-readiness-v1.json).\n\n'
t=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"The schedule completes 900 updates/100 ADC skips/3,600 images. A real step-8 checkpoint restores model, Adam, EMA and CPU/CUDA RNG state exactly and continues at step 9 without replay. All 1,000 cache/input/parent/unit bindings, {t['FP32_loss_totals_checked']} independently summed NumPy FP32 loss totals, 900 inherited mask fingerprints, 141 final Adam states and both strict endpoints pass. All trainable tensors receive nonzero gradients. State restoration does not imply a bit-exact retraining trajectory.\n\n"
text+=f"Quality completes 1,644 composed calls, 1,500 candidate matching calls and 7,500 nested samplers. All 1,644 V169 fingerprints replay exactly and 144 ADC final outputs retain V169. All 6,576 actual input fingerprints and durable event/row bindings pass. Independent in-process FP32 residual addition covers {audit['allcase_inprocess_addition_channels']:,} channels. V172/V173/V171 numeric comparisons reuse previously audited scores on identical cached inputs, not new inference.\n\n"
text+=f"Full new RGB arrays cover only 36 selected native cases: 72 RGB plus 72 residuals, 430,196,736 bytes. Independent posthoc metrics/addition check those arrays, {audit['scalar_checks']} scalars and {audit['independent_native_addition_channels']:,} channels. Other outputs were scored/fingerprinted and independently norm/decomposition/addition checked in process but not retained. No complete all-822 new-array archive/posthoc audit is claimed. Decimal arithmetic checks {paired['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']} grouped means.\n\n"
text+='The six primary EMA offset captures reuse existing quality forwards and retain 30 FP32 pre-tanh tensors, 102,780,672 bytes. An independent posthoc audit binds all arrays to actual input/parent/prediction records and reconstructs the five blocks’ sample-position distributions. This measures positions on six inputs, not causal contribution of distant samples or a whole-pipeline receptive field. [Offset audit](results/v174-spread-matching-v1/offset-audit-v1.json).\n\n'
text+=f"Candidate matching work totals {execution['total_new_candidate_matching_CUDA_calls']:,} CUDA calls; the baseline probe adds six V172 calls, for {execution['total_new_matching_CUDA_calls']:,} new matching calls in total and no CPU matching-core calls. Frozen-component CUDA calls total {execution['total_frozen_component_CUDA_calls']:,}; these are nested components, not DINO-parent calls. All four recorded owners are terminal without a failed scientific phase or repeated prefix. Training/quality CUDA peaks are {execution['peak_training_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f}/{execution['peak_quality_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f} GiB. No new full-frame/100MP or ten-second claim is made.\n\n"
text+='Reserves are 49/110 GiB local/external plus 0.5 GiB projection margin, 32 GiB runtime RAM, 52 GiB launch RAM and 24 GiB CUDA. Older guards and receipt bytes remain unchanged. Existing MIT and embedded Caffe sampler notices remain in provenance.\n\n'
text+='## Fixed native comparisons\n\n'
text+='All 60 figures were actually viewed in 15 original-detail sheets: 48 boards and 12 noisy/restored/exact constructed GT triplets. Each cell is 160×160 native pixels without resizing. Sources/ROIs, checkpoint hashes, noise conditioning, exposure, camera transform, contrast and anchors are in the manifest. Mesh uses RGGB 512, ROI [176,176,160,160], shot 0.00128/read variance 6.5536e-6, exposure 8 and contrast 1/40. Quiet uses ROI [80,176,160,160], exposure 8 and contrast 40; flats use ROI [176,176,160,160], exposure 4 and contrast 40. ISO12800 uses shot 0.00256/read variance 2.62144e-5. [Photographic credits](fine-mesh-training.md#photographic-credits).\n\n'
text+='Main DSCF3879 ISO6400/DSCF3880 ISO100 includes sky, building, foliage and coarse fence at exposure 4. Cab DSCF3842/3835 includes both priors, windows [206,229,160,160]/[426,189,160,160] in 768-pixel contexts, exposure 16 and both camera JPEGs. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references differ in aperture, shutter, motion and processing; they are qualitative, not exact GT and not pixelwise scored. [Main scene](../configs/gfx-qualitative-20231231.json) · [Fine cab mesh](../configs/gfx-green-mesh-20231231.json).\n\n'
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
for triplet,title in [(False,'All native comparison boards'),(True,'Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT triplets')]:
 text+='### '+title+'\n\n'
 for item in figures['images']:
  if item['triplet']!=triplet:continue
  text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n![Native comparison](images/v174-spread-matching-v1/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
text+='[Independent publication verification](results/v174-spread-matching-publication-verification-v1.json).\n'
report=repo/'docs/spread-sample-matching.md';report.write_text(text)
save(root/'report-bindings-v1.json',dict(status='built-from-completed-audits-and-actual-native-notes',report=ref(report),notes=ref(notes),cells=cells,lines=lines,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
print('Built',len(cells),'metric cells;60 native figures')
